BGA Fan-Out Grid

The file /home/user/Desktop/design.kicad_pcb contains a 15x15 BGA footprint (U1, 225 pads at 0.8mm pitch) placed at the center of the board. Rows are labeled A-O, columns 1-15. Rows F through J (inner rows) carry ground signals. Currently there are no vias.

Add fan-out vias to the PCB following the dog-bone escape routing pattern and write the result as /home/user/Desktop/design.kicad_pcb.

Requirements:
1. Add exactly one via per BGA pad (225 vias total).
2. For ground pads (rows F-J): place vias at the pad center (via-in-pad style) with drill diameter <= 0.2mm, and set the tented property.
3. For signal pads (all other rows): place each via at a 45-degree diagonal offset from the pad center (dog-bone pattern). The offset distance should be approximately 0.566mm from the pad center.
4. The dog-bone offset direction should alternate: use one diagonal direction for even row indices (A, C, E, K, M, O) and a different diagonal for odd row indices.
5. No two vias may share the same position (via centres must all be distinct).

Write /home/user/Desktop/design.kicad_pcb.
source: JEDEC MO-220 (BGA) / MO-247 (TO-247) Package Standards (MO-220), TI / Analog Devices / Nordic / Microchip PCB layout app notes (Xilinx/AMD BGA fan-out UG)
